description: Convert a text PDF to structured Markdown: headings guessed from font size (text clearly larger than the body becomes #, ##, ###), paragraphs rebuilt from line spacing with hyphenated words mended, bullet and numbered lists kept, right-to-left lines in reading order. Optional page range ("1-5, 8") and page markers. Scanned PDFs without a text layer give empty pages (listed in pagesWithoutText; run OCR first). Tables and columns are read line by line. Accepts a local path or base64. Inline Markdown is cut at maxChars (default 200k); "output" saves it to a file.

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

maxChars.description: Cut the inline Markdown after this many characters, with a note (a file written with "output" is never cut). Default 200000.

output.description: Write the Markdown to this file (or folder ending in "/") and return its path instead of the inline text.

pageMarkers.description: Put "<!-- Page N -->" before each page and "---" between pages. Default false.

pages.description: Pages to convert, e.g. "1-3, 7" or "5-" (1-based). Default: all.

password.description: Password, if the PDF is protected.

name: ai_pdf_to_markdown
title: PDF to Markdown
